rules.description: Verification for all scholarship schemes consists of exactly two phases.
rules.condition: For all the aforesaid scholarship schemes
rules.outcome: Only two-phase verification will be available
rules.evidence_quote: Only two phase verification will be available for all the aforesaid scholarship schemes.

rules.description: The first verification level is conducted at the school or institute.
rules.condition: During the first level of verification
rules.outcome: Verification will be done at the School/Institute level
rules.evidence_quote: The first level of verification will be done at the School/Institute level

rules.description: The second verification level is conducted at the district authority for NCT of Delhi and Uttar Pradesh, and at the state/UT authority for other regions.
rules.condition: During the second level of verification
rules.outcome: Verification will be at the District Authority level (for NCT of Delhi and Uttar Pradesh) and the State/UT concerned (for others)
rules.evidence_quote: second level of verification will be at the District Authority level (for NCT of Delhi and Uttar Pradesh) and the State/UT concerned (for others).
